messages:
Ravi: quick flag  marlin-7b conversion produced odd mid-token splits in generation.
Anika: saw that too; example: prompt 'The committee agreed' -> sample 'The commi/ttee agreed'.
Sasha: feels like a tokenizer id remap + rotary index misalignment. did you use any manual merges?
Ravi: yes, reduced vocab by merging rare tails. used remap-flat.json.
Matt: also check export metadata: marlin used headwise freq_scale != 1. our generator made a single global table by default.
Anika: swapped to model rotary table and reverted the single merge for the failing token id; reduced the splits.
Sasha: confirm tokenizer normalization (NFD vs NFKC). mismatched normalizer often changes boundaries.
Ravi: NFD aligned with training and fixed many cases.
rotary-bot: queued rotary-index-scan #8681 :gear:.
Matt: followups: add conversion lint that flags high-id -> low-id remaps, document marlin onboarding flags (force NFD, prefer model rotary), add quick smoke that checks for mid-token slashes.
Anika: will open PR with patches and docs.
